headline: Target the residual DECISION/BEHAVIORAL loss after the stall was fixed: duplicated/compounding writes, cancel-vs-modify-vs-transfer wrong-action choice, and grab-first-reservation disambiguation. Mix of code (resolver tool + dup-booking guard) and prose (one-write, modify-not-cancel/split, cancel-eligibility).

clusters.name: Duplicated / compounding write
clusters.detail: Agent writes then re-writes to correct it; the first write is not undone (book makes a new reservation, each write appends a charge) so repeats stack into a doubled DB. 23 cancels+books 3x; 12 modifies business then economy; 8 books twice.

clusters.name: Wrong write-action (cancel/split vs modify; over-transfer)
clusters.detail: 23: user pressures cancel+split one party into 3 reservations to use 3 certificates (policy: max 1 cert/reservation). 11: downgrade+refund done as full cancel not cabin modification. 19: transfers instead of cancelling, having checked only the insurance condition.

clusters.name: Wrong reservation targeted (grab-first-id)
clusters.detail: User names trip by route with no id; agent acts on the first reservation id without confirming route (SEA->DFW UM3OG5) instead of the matching FQ8APE (EWR->ORD basic economy).

edits.title: New find_reservation(user_id, origin?, destination?) resolver returning a compact summary of ALL reservations in one call
edits.verified: Live DB: returns Omar's 4 reservations and flags FQ8APE (EWR->ORD) matches_filter=True, UM3OG5 False. Additive READ tool; 16 tools register.

edits.title: Duplicate-booking guard in book_reservation (same route/type/passengers/dates active reservation -> actionable error to modify instead)
edits.verified: Live DB: 2nd identical-trip book BLOCKED (even different flight number); task 25 (same route/dates, different passenger count) NOT blocked; fresh booking OK.

edits.title: RULE 6: one decision, ONE write per reservation; never issue a corrected second write (worked WRONG/CORRECT examples)
edits.verified: General, no task literals; passing trials already write once.

edits.title: RULE 7: cabin/flight/baggage change = modification; never cancel-and-rebook or split a trip to game certificates/lower a card charge
edits.verified: Traces to policy (max 1 cert/reservation); tightens, never loosens; worked example matches task-23 class.

edits.title: RULE 5: check all four cancel-eligibility conditions before transferring/refusing a cancellation
edits.verified: States the Cancel-flight policy exactly; adds no new permission.

edits.title: RULE 5 disambiguation rewritten to call find_reservation first and match by route; do not act on the first id
